headline: Google tests AI-powered Playground platform for creating browser games
summary: Google introduced Playground, an AI-powered platform that lets users create browser-based games using simple text prompts. Engadget described it as launched, while TechCrunch characterized it as an experimental project still being developed by Google Labs.
